localLink.changes: Cooperative single-thread scheduling of two independent native mCore instances in one WASM module. ROM, RAM, RTC, peripherals and framebuffer remain separate. Browser confirmation commits both save owners atomically; no new network protocol. Original Jeffrey Pfau copyright/MPL notice retained; existing native save/state formats and IDs unchanged.

saveCompletionObserver.changes: Lightweight per-core dirty/quiet counters around the pinned native savedata callbacks; no frame-by-frame copy, filesystem or network I/O. Import/reset/state restore reset the observer baseline. Native source archive, battery/state layouts and compatibility identifiers remain unchanged. Both independent rebuild outputs match; see sources/build-evidence.json saveCompletionBuild.

loggingPolicy.changes: Native trace suppression before formatting/JS output; eight engine warnings/errors per load and all fatal messages retained. Save/state ABI and source archive unchanged. Two independent rebuilds match; see loggingBuild in build-evidence.json.

romOwnership.changes: Transfer temporary ROM allocation once; consume on success and failure. Expose compiled GBA save capacity before structural compatibility correction. Preserve copying ABI, stored original, battery/state layouts and link drivers. Two independent builds match.

startupMemory.changes: Reject missing mandatory GBA work/extended/video RAM and audio buffer before loading/executing a cartridge. Destroy partial core and consume ROM on failure. Owned loader returns -1 for checked allocation failures; original copying ABI stays 0/1. No change to native archive, save/state formats or link drivers. Not a comprehensive native allocator audit.
